## Checklist
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`, etc.)
- [ ] Single logical change (split large PRs)
- [ ] No unrelated formatting changes
- [ ] `.editorconfig` respected
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or machine-specific paths
- [ ] OBS independence maintained (no copied code/assets without license)
- [ ] REA attribution preserved where applicable
- [ ] Security implications considered
